headline: Parents Say Yes to AI, With Guardrails
thesis: As parents back classroom AI on condition of safeguards, the training and evidence gaps behind that ask are coming into focus.
summary: A new national survey covered by EdSurge finds most parents want students using AI in school with strong safeguards, while 43% of surveyed teachers report no AI training. Inside Higher Ed's recent coverage shows the same gap on campus: Educause's top-10 now leads with AI value, and Instructure data suggests only 11% of instructors have comprehensive AI training. Interoperability stays in view ahead of the Ed-Fi Summit (Nov 9–11), and 1EdTech's Nov 12 session asks what GenAI must prove.
footnote: Compiled from 11 curated edtech sources · NOVEMBER 5, 2026 · Built from search results rather than direct site fetches; several sources had no items dated today and show recent or evergreen items.
